## Purpose

Describe the reusable public-facing change.

## Publication safety

- [ ] I reviewed the complete diff.
- [ ] No personal data, photographs, financial records, credentials, private links, or infrastructure details are included.
- [ ] No unpublished research or private project evidence is included.
- [ ] Real examples were replaced with synthetic examples or are already public and cited.
- [ ] AI-assisted text was reviewed by a person.

## Validation

- [ ] Local Markdown links resolve.
- [ ] The change does not assume that a connector's `Connected` status proves repository access.
